messages:
anna: HelioGrid confirmed Thurs for a joint perf/W session. They asked for a short artifact list and an owners table. Can everyone call their pieces? cc @rafael @priya

rafael: I can own kernel variants. Will provide two builds: stock and low-power-sched. I’ll also export the perf-event list and a build SHA. ETA Tue EOD.

priya: I’ll push runtime images (runtime:2.9-helio and runtime:2.9-quant) and a tarball for their air-gapped lab. Will publish digests to the sheet.

nate: Telemetry & infra here. I’ll bring prometheus scrape, an IPMI poll script for the wall meter, and a small merger that aligns timestamps. Also confirm SSH keys with HelioGrid ops.

anna: Workloads: gptj + 7B-llama, seq lengths 256/1024, batches 1/4. Two modes: capped-pstate and uncapped burst. Please record KV-cache hit rate and token-rate.

rafael: Kernel build snippet (for reproducibility):
```bash
make -j12 MODE=release KERNEL_TAG=low_power_sched
git rev-parse --short HEAD > /results/kernel_sha.txt
```
Telemetry example:
```bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,power.draw,utilization.gpu --format=csv -lms 200 > /results/gpu.csv &
while sleep 0.5; do ipmitool sdr get "WG-MPX"; done > /results/wall.txt &
```

priya: Run snippet I’ll include in artifacts:
```bash
export RUN_ID=HELIO-2026-05-05-01
docker run --rm --gpus all -e RUN_ID -e SEQ=1024 -e BATCH=1 -v /results:/results ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.9-helio ./bench_runner.sh --model gptj --tokens 60000
```
Artifacts upload target: gs://redwood-helio/$RUN_ID. Set ACL for helio-team@heliogrid.com.

nate: Ops checklist: dry-run in our lab Mon, push artifacts Tue, pre-run sync Wed 16:00 with Helio ops, partner run Thu. If dry-run perf/W deviates >10% pause and debug.

anna: Legal/marketing note: no public release until partner signoff. I’ll draft a one-paragraph joint statement template after we have dry-run numbers.

rafael: I’ll also add a small postproc script (tools/bench/helio_postproc.py) to merge gpu.csv + wall.txt + harness JSON -> perf_per_w.csv.

infra-bot: Rack reserved: HELIO-RACK-3 Thu 09:00-17:00. Ticket HEL-9002.

priya: Can everyone drop their short 3-step run instructions by Tue noon so I can assemble the 1-page runbook?

anna: Thanks team  owners: rafael=kernels, priya=images & comms, nate=telemetry & infra, anna=runbook & partner liaison. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
